assumptions: reconstructed JONSWAP boundary (peak period = mean / 0.84): swell (spreading 20 deg) and wind sea (30 deg) as two peaks where the model gives them, else one peak (30 deg)
one offshore wave model per hour, the one closest to the others

regional DTM, not current sandbar survey
